transcript: Agent: Hello! Thank you for contacting support. || Customer: My order arrived damaged. || Agent: I am so sorry to hear that. I understand how frustrating this is. Please share your order number. || Customer: It is 4521. || Agent: Thank you. I have processed a refund and it is completed. || Customer: Great thanks that was helpful! || Agent: Is there anything else I can help with? Have a great day!

Agent: Yes? || Customer: My internet is not working and I am angry. || Agent: Restart the router. || Customer: I did that already. This is terrible service. || Agent: Nothing else I can do. || Customer: Unacceptable. I want to cancel.

Agent: Hi and welcome! How can I help? || Customer: I forgot my password. || Agent: Sure I can help. Please check your email for a reset link. || Customer: Got it works now perfect. || Agent: Happy to help. Is there anything else? Take care!
Agent: Hello. || Customer: Why is my bill so high? Worst service ever. || Agent: Don't be stupid its on the plan. || Customer: I will file a complaint. This is awful. || Agent: Whatever.

Agent: Good morning thank you for calling. || Customer: I need to change my address. || Agent: Certainly please give me the new address. || Customer: 12 Park Street. || Agent: Done it is updated. I apologize for the wait. || Customer: Thank you good. || Agent: Anything else? Have a nice day.
Agent: Hello welcome. || Customer: My app keeps crashing and I am frustrated. || Agent: I understand. Please try reinstalling. || Customer: Still not working. || Agent: I am sorry
column7: I will escalate this to our technical team please wait for their call. || Customer: Okay thanks.
